title: Epic Spawn Eggs
description: A datapack that changes the rarity of all Spawn Eggs to be Epic.
body:
⚠️ **This datapack requires the [Item Components](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-components) mod to function! It does nothing without it.** ⚠️

⚠️ **This datapack requires the [Spawn Egg Item Tag](https://modrinth.com/datapack/spawn-egg-item-tag) datapack to function! It does nothing without it.** ⚠️

This datapack makes all vanilla Spawn Eggs have the Epic rarity, meaning they will have a purple name just like the rest of the creative mode only items.

This datapack wouldn't be possible without the work of [boyonk](https://modrinth.com/user/boyonk), go check out their mods! Especially the one this datapack requires.
